name: Girl & Scarecrow
source:
[i]If out of bed on summer’s night
You hear the crack of lightning bright,
And spying there a shadowed shape, 
Fear not, my girl, nor flee in fright
The scarecrow’s on his watch tonight.[/i]

Your father said he'd be back before Christmas. That was two years ago.

Now your mother's moving to work at a radar station in the rural edges of New Zealand, and unfortunately for you, she's taking you with her. To make matters worse, there's something rotten lurking in the bush beyond your grandfather's house... and it's coming for the two of you.

Oh, and don't think the scarecrow will help you. He's useless.

[b]Girl & Scarecrow is a short fantasy visual novel game with a moderate amount of choice, eight or so characters, a couple endings and a big rat.[/b]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781310]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]夏夜惊雷破长空，
倘若起身离床榻，
瞥见暗影立窗外，
莫怕莫逃好姑娘，
今宵稻草人守望。[/i]

爸爸说过他会在圣诞节前回家。那已经是两年前的事了。

如今，妈妈要搬去新西兰偏远乡间的雷达站工作，而对你来说不幸的是，她打算把你也一并带上。更糟糕的是，外公家屋后的灌木丛里潜伏着某种腐朽的怪异之物……而且它正冲着你们母女二人而来。

哦，千万别指望那个稻草人会帮上忙。他一点用都没有。

[b]《少女与稻草人》是一款短篇奇幻视觉小说游戏，包含适量的分支选项、八名左右的角色、数个结局，外加一只大耗子。[/b]

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781310]Steam[/url]]
